name: rea-agents: v6.4.0
body:
## [6.4.0](https://github.com/morluto/rea/compare/rea-agents-6.3.0...rea-agents-6.4.0) (2026-10-11)

### Highlights

- Android: added device inspection, split-APK acquisition, logs, screenshots, file transfers and explicit app lifecycle actions through ADB, plus manifest and localized-string decoding with Apktool. ([#1552](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1552), [#1556](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1556)) Thanks @3QL.
- JEB: browse project units and decompile selected items through a caller-started local JEB MCP server. ([#1536](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1536)) Thanks @3QL.
- Large analyses: discover retained Evidence without loading every payload, and inspect JavaScript graphs, binary layouts and function dossiers through summaries and selected views. ([#1682](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1682), [#1568](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1568), [#1570](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1570), [#1345](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1345), [#1507](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1507), [#1247](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1247)) Thanks @jhuang-tw, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @N0zoM1z0.
- JavaScript: isolate source analysis in an owned process with configurable heap and timeout limits; retain completed facts and explicit unknowns when analysis runs out of resources. ([#1651](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1651), [#1563](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1563), [#1565](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1565)) Thanks @N0zoM1z0, @peter-research.
- Ghidra: configure import language/compiler specifications and seed functions, code and labels before auto-analysis. ([#1667](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1667)) Thanks @sqmagellan.
- RPC discovery: recognize supported tRPC calls, HTTP-link URLs and named GraphQL operations in JavaScript applications and web bundles. ([#1670](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1670)) Thanks @pompiliodonatoapp.

### Changes

- Added Ghidra support for Windows PE DLLs and bounded MIPS ELF analysis, including carved MIPS inputs with incomplete section tables. Windows P0 remains read-only. ([#1303](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1303), [#1362](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1362), [#1629](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1629), [#1290](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1290), [#718](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/718), [#1619](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1619)) Thanks @bqw371, @jaelliot, @kvalls, @N0zoM1z0.
- Enabled `set_address_name` and `set_addresses_names` for Ghidra sessions with mutation authority, including namespace-aware data labels and per-address batch results. ([#1635](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1635), [#1634](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1634)) Thanks @giri256.
- Recovered additional signed AArch64 relative jump-table patterns. ([#1592](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1592)) Thanks @RishTheFish21.
- Added PE resource inspection and read-only NativeAOT metadata parsing for supported x64 PE32+/.NET 8 RTR 9.1 inputs. The NativeAOT parser’s Windows-host Ghidra workflow remains unverified on a real Windows host. ([#1482](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1482), [76d8f68](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/76d8f68cb918dfb43869f2b649a0b6c0c1cf266d), [#1254](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1254)) Thanks @N0zoM1z0, @thangldw.
- Added Pi, Hermes and Qwen Code setup, including Hermes active-profile support. ([#1376](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1376), [#1403](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1403), [#1415](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1415), [#1409](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1409)) Thanks @rasatpetabit, @yiliang114, @zaydiscold.
- Added `REA_MCP_INPUT_SCHEMA_PROFILE=compact` for size-capped MCP clients such as Kimi/Moonshot, while retaining canonical runtime validation. ([#1514](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1514), [#1580](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1580), [#1484](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1484), [#1581](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1581)) Thanks @haythemsellami, @N0zoM1z0.
- Added live process-capture progress and optional `finalization_ms` to capture shutdown output before timeout escalation; cancellation remains immediate. ([#1483](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1483), [#1583](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1583), [#1252](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1252), [#1253](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1253), [modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk#2997](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk/issues/2997)) Thanks @N0zoM1z0, @nikolay-dementiev, @sathariels.
- Improved Codex onboarding and recovery from observed client, PATH and provider blockers. ([#1613](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1613)) Thanks @N0zoM1z0.
- Reduced redirected JSON and terminal output size, and deferred heavy imports until their commands need them. ([#1413](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1413), [#1450](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1450), [#1439](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1439), [21dbcf7](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/21dbcf7a1458219989ad291e44ce7d017378b727)) Thanks @kaoru0822-kitauji.

### Fixes

- Electron analysis: follow renamed and default-imported APIs and optional calls, ignore overwritten identities and media preload attributes, and resolve packaged `app.asar` pages and unpacked companions. ([#1391](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1391), [#1393](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1393), [#1400](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1400), [#1664](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1664), [#1673](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1673)) Thanks @kaoru0822-kitauji, @marnixpluim, @N0zoM1z0, @suninrain086.
- JavaScript data flow: preserve returned/yielded reference uncertainty, invalidate property-stored aliases correctly, and retain bundled-module runtime scope. ([#1437](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1437), [#1445](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1445), [#1471](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1471), [#1577](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1577), [#1428](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1428), [#1442](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1442), [#1449](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1449), [#1576](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1576)) Thanks @CassieFox23, @dakjdakd, @N0zoM1z0.
- JavaScript packages: resolve exact exports subpaths, preserve trailing-slash directory requests and exact CommonJS keys, and respect shadowed `require` bindings. ([#1424](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1424), [#1615](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1615), [5485483](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/5485483f7da2f6cb66441bb784aaf2a1a5f8731a), [8b2f851](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/8b2f8514c50e469c3add8ce9ba7ebebef888b14f), [f998fcb](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/f998fcb1cca9994c3589fb70d6e0127fc215f76f), [1e51c73](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/1e51c732bbf08191688d6526bf58ab2650b601e3), [#1365](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1365)) Thanks @akshitkhokhani, @AWUQAQ, @immanuwell, @rudycelekli.
- Large JavaScript inputs: handle oversized inline source maps, deep returns and reassignment loops; avoid argument expansion limits and yield during large analysis passes. ([#1386](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1386), [#1368](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1368), [#1390](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1390), [#1539](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1539), [#1525](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1525), [#1542](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1542), [#1545](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1545), [#1557](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1557), [#1380](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1380), [#1401](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1401), [#1538](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1538), [#1462](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1462)) Thanks @cold-atom, @KadirJeager, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @marnixpluim, @N0zoM1z0, @rudycelekli.
- JavaScript receivers: expand escaped methods once, index returned-object targets, and avoid replaying earlier writes or duplicating retained graph allocations. ([#1517](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1517), [#1537](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1537), [#1444](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1444), [#1601](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1601), [#1495](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1495)) Thanks @CassieFox23, @geekwolf, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @N0zoM1z0, @zeynelacikgoez.
- Browser captures: retain WebSocket URLs, empty connections and frame order; compare only common known payload coverage and preserve incomplete WebMCP replay coverage. ([db4e360](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/db4e3608465486466591b594cf77037ac150c988), [aa257ea](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/aa257ea4b16f2d2a35c12df63359d650b48b1154), [e52c0a7](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/e52c0a72c59c740315e89149881a27ce4d89a11c))
- Browser scenarios: seed storage in the correct partition, normalize loopback attach identities, retain declared-secret redaction and require verified lineage before Windows Electron signals. ([#1604](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1604), [#1590](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1590), [#1588](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1588), [8b4c3de](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/8b4c3de3b3a3b580adec266f94f29ccedf1da228), [#1497](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1497), [#1591](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1591), [#1589](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1589)) Thanks @Adolanium, @akushonkamen, @dakjdakd.
- Added Termux Android browser-scenario support. ([#1655](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1655)) Thanks @tyloryang.
- Web inputs: accept BOM-prefixed HAR, preserve the first duplicate DOM attribute and resolve SVG/XLink URLs in HTML and XHTML. ([#1509](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1509), [#1516](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1516), [#1602](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1602), [#1683](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1683), [#1496](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1496), [#1586](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1586)) Thanks @CassieFox23, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @sathariels, @taljeri.
- Screenshot comparisons: validate PNG chunks, distinguish corruption from unsupported encodings and bound comparison memory. ([4e4b15b](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/4e4b15b8250b29e176d4191c9610a3931b693474), [b3e977e](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/b3e977e6d073ab1783cece8581279f87fc360411)) Thanks @rudycelekli.
- Archives: preserve case-distinct names, report collisions at their diverging segment, detect nested formats from bytes and reject Windows alternate-stream extraction paths. ([#1480](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1480), [#1505](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1505), [#1553](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1553), [573598c](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/573598c6324698cc48ceafd24ed3864670e08d00), [#1470](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1470), [#1491](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1491)) Thanks @CassieFox23, @kaoru0822-kitauji.
- Cleanup: retain failed readers, ASAR handles, output trees and provider workers for retry without discarding completed output or partial observations. ([ffe0574](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/ffe0574e17b9d973860371083cb1a351be912131), [de0d341](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/de0d341524dc68250a45b41eb7e49fcecc1e32a9), [3f8c51e](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/3f8c51e9b506d88fc41aded7b1a22b9a09037c26), [d1235fa](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/d1235fadc901e1fb9ab3149d53063306c8545414), [026126e](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/026126eafe741e5a8b857433587fd615cdd44c19))
- Providers: canonicalize IDA workspace roots before identity checks, respect IDA cancellation, serialize JEB acquisition and correct Ghidra no-return/imported-symbol recovery. ([#1481](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1481), [#1419](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1419), [5f30ea6](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/5f30ea6ff2dd89aab7af6da6e8dfa5e508ed459b), [f88c990](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/f88c99021b88ce67e513025901f57478d8107d0c), [49e6f00](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/49e6f00ed08b225abf9ddb7c762553607fdab115)) Thanks @AS9929, @JonahSimon, @Y0UW1SH.
- Binary metadata: respect PE/.NET section extents, bound binary-plist expansion, scope keyed-archive traversal and decode app `Info.plist` files without `plutil`. ([#1678](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1678), [#1515](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1515), [#1378](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1378), [#1476](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1476), [975dff2](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/975dff2e25b14b634e14dd5e0db1537d0ca9815b), [76296c5](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/76296c5a3868ba3b54be6ed3896719283d6de5f8)) Thanks @jayhemnani9910, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @rudycelekli.
- Windows runtimes: preserve drive-root paths when creating private provider directories. ([ee46323](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/ee46323b493994902b04824a7dc8aae2a8117903))
- Compatibility: load Windows native controls under Node-API hosts with renamed executables, preserve dylib directory requirements, support Wakaru 1.x and reject directory-valued Hopper launchers. ([#1531](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1531), [#1623](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1623), [#1540](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1540), [#1426](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1426)) Thanks @evenafterallisaid, @Fazmin, @pionxzh, @xeropresence.
- Reference imports: normalize internal symlink lookup consistently, preserve exact paths and exclusion provenance, report root access failures and reject FIFO replacements without blocking. ([#1535](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1535), [2ca3ad2](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/2ca3ad238608adfca80a7ff1aaadea6e59a58225), [6636045](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/6636045c9c5b472bba51afee9d434394861e93a4), [3967cfa](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/3967cfa43e786c65a57e89c265343983d19ef9d0), [f1c58cc](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/f1c58cc53fbd83b968e11b3e2eccebca51299c54)) Thanks @anujsingh-cse.
- Setup: honor active configuration and skill roots, preserve configured MCP environments, validate Hermes/OMP profiles before writing, recognize Omarchy and retain recovery backups. ([#1504](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1504), [#1607](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1607), [#1528](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1528), [#1562](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1562), [#1662](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1662), [a011485](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/a01148553e2a37c72ae78405418ab648876a96a6), [#1606](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1606), [#1521](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1521), [#1561](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1561)) Thanks @Adkid-Zephyr, @CassieFox23, @LuisTaffelli, @N0zoM1z0, @peter-research.
- Process capture: retain descendant lineage after launcher exit, preserve identity uncertainty before signaling and release terminals after observation failures. ([80896a1](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/80896a1d64b216ef893907249cd4252f86215d49), [c916850](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/c9168508527302ac57bc86385ccf0d824697b5dc)) Thanks @Y0UW1SH.
- CLI/MCP errors: accept JSON files for web comparisons, preserve native option help and union correction details, remove invalid aliases and validate doctor against its discovered output contract. ([#1397](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1397), [#1395](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1395), [#1425](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1425), [#1461](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1461), [8b4c96e](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/8b4c96e6c6b3ed6806e4cd72b556b5db6114304a), [#1421](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1421), [#1454](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1454)) Thanks @Fazmin, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @N0zoM1z0.

### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

- WebSocket results: use `network.websocket_connections` instead of `network.websocket_events`. Connections contain `request_id`, `url` and `events`; allow `payload_bytes: null` when size is unknown. No legacy alias remains. ([db4e360](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/db4e3608465486466591b594cf77037ac150c988))
- Direct resource APIs: pass a caller-owned `ArtifactResourceScope` to inventory/extraction, JavaScript analysis, reference imports and web exports; retain it through cleanup/shutdown. For `readJavaScriptArtifactFiles`, scope is argument three and abort signal is argument four. Keep each root inventory source’s single cleanup owner. Use `OwnedFileHandle` owners, injected ASAR `fd`/`read` handles instead of `createReadStream`, VCS `Result` values, and `WebScriptExportError`’s options object. CLI/MCP inputs for the scoped operations are unchanged. ([ffe0574](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/ffe0574e17b9d973860371083cb1a351be912131), [53e7fad](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/53e7fadbd078422ba3d55b5499a70d237c5f4908), [684199b](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/684199ba0be7822266d57ddb8a40e95f087fdc42), [be75ed5](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/be75ed5e4b4bfb146af497f8fa5d172a1ea19462), [be6272f](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/be6272f26115bd8e94f2ab0df4cf092004587a18), [e0e49e9](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/e0e49e9dd53d9d1f1d2330b23f7f880dc1c81774), [95a77b6](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/95a77b6e25420b3879bd0e32bdbb14d452b38776))
- Saved reference graphs: exclusions require their matching `pattern` and distinguish `project-ignored` from `default-ignored`. Re-import graphs missing that provenance. ([6585293](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/6585293c562853b95c3a70df02c12ad8cc17afc4))
- Terminal captures: keep initial and resized buffers within 1,000,000 cells using `columns × (rows + scrollback)`; oversized scenarios are rejected before launch. ([f9ea9a9](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/f9ea9a9268c854d31048da9f8a50cfa37703fe5a))
- Optional agent-verification reports: accept schema version 4, nullable `expectedFirstTool` and `targetClarificationPassed`. Production CLI/MCP contracts are unchanged. ([#1613](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1613))
- Capture comparisons: recapture both sides with matching `literal-replacements-v1` semantics when custom normalization patterns are used. Legacy unversioned pattern captures remain readable but cannot be compared with new pattern captures; captures without patterns are unaffected. ([#1456](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1456), [2b6f14f](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/2b6f14f528297cf12c776c960af0859f5cfbefbf)) Thanks @Madhavan006, @N0zoM1z0.
- Artifact graph edges: read child artifact IDs and paths from the occurrence selected by `occurrence_id`, not edge fields `child_artifact_id`/`logical_path`. Earlier inventory Evidence no longer validates against the new commitment. ([#1493](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1493)) Thanks @kaoru0822-kitauji.
- Semantic graph schema: nodes and relations no longer include `identifier_strategy`, and relation IDs no longer hash it. Earlier Evidence no longer validates against this schema. ([#1474](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1474)) Thanks @kaoru0822-kitauji.
- Semantic identities: select IDs from the parent graph; read exact event names from `event_name`, endpoints from `endpoint` and literal values from `properties.value`. New analyses use digest-based IDs for long/reserved event and endpoint names and `value-sha256` literal role keys, with shorter labels; string literal labels now read `string literal`. Previously stored graphs retain their original IDs and remain valid workflow inputs. ([#1427](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1427), [#1423](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1423), [#1407](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1407)) Thanks @N0zoM1z0.

### Contributors

- Thanks also to @BaaRai, @commit-regrets, @coygeek, @Franky100-pig, @inii-sayaa, @jopemachine, @JosephDemarest, @keemsisi, @Totopo27 for contributions included in this release.

Full contribution record: [336 commits and 163 merged PRs](https://github.com/morluto/rea/blob/rea-agents-6.4.0/docs/releases/6.4.0.contributions.json).

name: v0.8.147
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.147

Released on 2026-10-11.

A render that stalls now says which step Chrome hung in. It also says what to do, such as letting another heavy GPU or CPU job finish first.

## Fixes

- **Engine:** A render stall names the step Chrome hung in and says what to do ([bb34e301e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bb34e301ec3c5f7b9edad07932356bd02a9f7934), [#5450](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5450)).

## Full changelog

https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/compare/v0.8.146...v0.8.147

name: v0.8.146
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.146

Released on 2026-10-11.

A split sub-composition now plays from its in-point in preview and on the timeline. FFmpeg installed while a preview runs is found without a restart, and exports no longer fail on a clip past the composition's end.

## Features

- **Core:** Truepeak, a lookahead true-peak limiter FX ([3746703ea77](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3746703ea77fa93eb9f8a8312058cf233b56776e), [#5419](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5419)).

## Fixes

- **CLI:** The browser download unpacks on machines without an unzip command ([9e9b613ccf8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9e9b613ccf867f98838617f7424967e056e63de2), [#5433](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5433)).
- **CLI:** Check warns when a video's browser-playable copy cannot be made ([bf7f6deae93](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bf7f6deae932b4793065c74c20d9184f099fc386), [#5441](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5441)).
- **CLI:** History reads answer while another app has the project open ([489036c8439](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/489036c8439408f38cecafded273ddf5752b9162), [#5445](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5445)).
- **Core:** A split sub-composition plays its videos from its in-point in preview and timeline ([480807ec4be](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/480807ec4be4c28a6ac190f863354bf8d6b7d4c7), [#5413](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5413)).
- **Parsers:** Find ffmpeg installed after a long-running preview started ([64c47cf3d1b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/64c47cf3d1b00aa6dd76a3d40256f235654eacb1), [#5439](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5439)).
- **Core:** A runtime failure just before start-up is named too ([721ebeafaa3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/721ebeafaa30acefbf8c169e2afc4b7d3e87ef23), [#5444](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5444)).
- **Core:** Slow clips stay on the playhead at reduced preview speeds ([7d958fea0ba](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7d958fea0ba01c80a023e366adfe8cb2f3d14a17), [#5440](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5440)).
- **Producer:** Exports no longer fail on a video clip outside the composition's length ([81f60dbc985](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/81f60dbc9850110273a4d0df9cfb32803476f13a), [#5431](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5431)).
- **Parsers:** Find FFmpeg and FFprobe installed by the project's npm installer packages ([748cda90697](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/748cda9069768ad5b1711379162fc22f1b1076a8), [#5434](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5434)).
- **Core:** A runtime that fails to start names its real error instead of a half-built page ([3aba29ce056](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3aba29ce056a76d81a9eb7b9d07f228a4d886903), [#5406](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5406)).
- **CLI:** Preview --background reports a preview that cannot start instead of waiting it out ([6c96ea53443](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6c96ea5344341c1648ec5df565eff2c1ba070519), [#5437](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5437)).
- **Lint:** A double-quoted media src with an apostrophe is read whole, not reported missing ([a9823f719df](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a9823f719df9a18e1ed004bede9a138c8a9adfc5), [#5411](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5411)).
- **Studio:** Studio's own text reads without em or en dashes ([9825614d91d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9825614d91de5ce9a8433aa09bc761e0d2cf369d), [#5414](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5414)).
- **Engine:** Copy border-width/style/color onto the replacement video frame ([e23b3a3e31d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e23b3a3e31d830ca432c98cc7b8c4a5ce067dcfb), [#3993](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3993)).
- **CLI:** Timeline split keeps a sub-composition's place in both halves ([165be851328](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/165be85132813b941987387d1cbaf870d1bd8653), [#5410](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5410)).

## Performance

- **Packages:** Ship npm packages without source maps and guard their size in CI ([bb9e507e840](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bb9e507e8408d7098aefc1b8bad418b5e8e12c92), [#5403](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5403)).
- **Engine:** Re-renders reuse the extracted frames of remote videos ([b6467d91315](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b6467d91315e800f6dd62641c2d98e5b8a9e8801), [#5408](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5408)).

## Catalog

- **Catalog:** Publish generated catalog ([faa4913c9ef](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/faa4913c9ef791733837eae4de1a579f2049b251), [#4340](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4340)).
- **Ci:** Let the catalog republish remove its stale simulated-cursor page and superseded fonts ([f2b81b24151](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f2b81b241516531c09ee90da6472beda3d6b4d46), [#5432](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5432)).

name: v18.9.1
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Added

- Added `compat.supportsThinkingBindingControls` for Bedrock Converse: setting it to `false` stops prefix-bound Claude requests from sending `thinking.block_binding`, the `thinking-binding-controls-2026-08-01` beta and the `/input_transformations` response path, for gateways or regions that reject them ([#15316](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15316) by [@harshaygadekar](https://github.com/harshaygadekar))

### Fixed

- Fixed Bedrock Claude Fable 5.1 requests with thinking off and a forced tool choice sending the forced choice next to adaptive thinking; the choice now falls back to `auto` ([#15316](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15316) by [@harshaygadekar](https://github.com/harshaygadekar))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Added

- Added the `supports-thinking-binding-controls` axis to Bedrock Converse models (on by default) so a rule or `models.yml` override can turn off Claude thinking-binding controls on hosts that reject them ([#15316](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15316) by [@harshaygadekar](https://github.com/harshaygadekar))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- Added `supportsThinkingBindingControls` to Bedrock `compat` in `models.yml`, so a Bedrock gateway or region that rejects Claude thinking-binding controls can turn them off ([#15316](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15316) by [@harshaygadekar](https://github.com/harshaygadekar))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Fixed

- Fixed executable scripts without a `#!` line failing with "Exec format error" in the embedded shell ([#15271](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15271) by [@iliaal](https://github.com/iliaal)).

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Fixed

- Fixed inline charts and images leaving overlapping copies over text when moved, resized, replaced, or hidden, while preserving images in scrollback.


## What's Changed
* fix(bedrock): add supportsThinkingBindingControls catalog opt-out by @harshaygadekar in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15316
* fix(shell): preserve executable text fallback with posix_spawn by @iliaal in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15271


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/compare/v18.9.0...v18.9.1

name: v18.9.0
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

### Fixed

- Fixed stale queue updates when queued steering is adopted, withdrawn, or added to the transcript, ensuring queue listeners consistently receive the latest state.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Breaking Changes

- Removed the `retainTextSignature` option from `consumeGoogleStream` and `streamGoogleGenAI`; Google routes now consistently preserve text reply signatures.
- Custom `SessionsApi` implementations must implement `permits(provider, sessionId, credentialId)`.

### Added

- Exported `matchesReplacementCredential` and `isSameOAuthAccount` to help identify credential replacement and account ownership.
- Added `AuthStorage.sessions.permits(provider, sessionId, credentialId)` for checking whether a stored account may serve a session restricted to an account pool.
- Added `judgeQuestions()` for loading judge questions from JSON with inferred choice labels and answer types, plus `renderQuestion()` for templated instructions.

### Changed

- Devin chat turns now use the native Devin CLI sampling settings by default, while continuing to honor explicitly configured temperature, top-p, and stop sequences.
- Added `parentSessionId` and `minimizeEffort` stream options. Branched side requests can reuse a conversation's prompt cache, and supported models can run them at their lowest effort without losing cache reuse.
- Improved cross-host continuation for supported models so confirmed prior reasoning is preserved as reasoning context rather than exposed as `<think>` text in replies.

### Fixed

- Fixed Anthropic subscription quota not appearing in `/usage` when an OAuth token is supplied through `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`.
- Fixed custom OpenAI-compatible Responses streams truncating reasoning and incorrectly invoking custom tools with empty input.
- Fixed Codex WebSocket prewarming so optional service tiers and model routing are handled consistently with normal requests.
- Fixed OAuth sign-in result pages breaking or rendering injected markup when provider errors or callback values contain special characters.
- Fixed Anthropic requests failing when tools are added to a conversation or when resumed sessions no longer include earlier tools.
- Fixed Anthropic requests rejecting tall or oversized historical screenshots by resizing or re-encoding images to the host's limits.
- Improved compatibility with Anthropic-compatible endpoints that reject prompt-cache options by retrying without unsupported caching features and reporting the disabled capability.
- LiteLLM proxy logs now group requests by omp conversation instead of displaying a separate session for each request.
- Fixed Gemini-family integrations echoing prior thinking as visible fenced `thinking` blocks; thinking is now restored as model reasoning across Google, Vertex, Antigravity, Gemini CLI, and Factory Droid routes.
- Fixed Gemini-family integrations losing text reply signatures needed for subsequent requests across Google, Vertex, Antigravity, Gemini CLI, and Factory Droid routes.
- Fixed Cursor integrations losing previously recorded reasoning, including signed and redacted reasoning, when continuing or resuming a conversation.
- Fixed invalid `auth.accountPolicies` entries referring to unavailable accounts from preventing startup, account selection, or login; such entries are now skipped with a warning.
- Fixed Factory Droid Claude turns with thinking disabled from replaying unsupported earlier thinking blocks, and aligned high-effort Sonnet 5.5 thinking behavior with the native client.
- Fixed side requests for GPT-6 Responses and Codex models from losing prompt-cache context or applying unsupported reasoning-effort configuration changes.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Fixed

- Fixed GLM-5.3-FlashX on Zhipu Coding Plan so bundled context, image, and reasoning-level capabilities are reported correctly.
- Fixed OpenRouter Decisions endpoint derivation when the chat base URL has a trailing slash.
- Fixed GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast usage pricing to apply OpenAI's published premium rates for the OpenAI API and Codex included usage.
- Fixed GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6.1 Sol, and GPT-6 Luna so changing reasoning effort preserves prompt caching.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- Added browser target discovery and control, allowing agents to list the user's available pages and operate an already-open Tern browser block instead of opening a new view.
- Added the `ctx.annotations` extension API for submitting and collecting `/annotate` feedback on text and diffs.
- Added configurable Extra Context Files under `/settings` → Context, allowing custom instruction filenames without editing YAML.
- Added optional composer predictions via `composer.predictions`, which suggest the user's next message as ghost text after each turn and support Tab or Right to accept the suggestion. Predictions use an additional model request and are included in session usage and `/stats`.
- Added structured async job metadata exposing native job status and child-agent identity alongside the job ID.
- Enhanced `tui.autoGraph: smart` with data-aware chart recommendations, including labels, grouping, ordering, shading, reference rows, measure direction, and suitable chart types.
- Added `retry.fallbackOn` to restrict model fallback to quota errors (`usage-limit`) or to non-quota errors (`except-usage-limit`), while retaining `any` as the default.
- Added `omp usage reset` commands to list saved Codex and Claude rate-limit resets and redeem a selected reset from the CLI, scripts, or auth-broker clients.
- Added warnings for saved Codex and Claude resets that are nearing expiry, including affected accounts and redemption targets; interactive sessions also show a one-time conversation warning.
- On macOS, the `computer` tool now keeps the display awake while operating and reports when the screen is locked or asleep.
- Tern browser open results now indicate when a page is not currently visible, helping agents direct users to hidden picture-in-picture or omp-tab views.

### Changed

- Improved `computer.window()` failure messages by listing open windows grouped by application, with the requested application shown first.
- Standalone binary updates and installers now use Stencil's build service with SHA-256 verification; recent updates use substantially smaller verified patches, and `--binary --ref` accepts release tags.
- After an omp upgrade, an unused older browser relay started by omp is automatically replaced on the next browser call so relay fixes take effect without manual shutdown.
- Saved Codex and Claude resets in non-interactive sessions are now automatically redeemed when they are about to expire, unless `autoRedeem: no` is configured.
- Background Claude reset salvage now checks only accounts with eligible usage, reducing unnecessary usage-limit traffic.
- Reasoning provenance is preserved when `/btw` answers are promoted or turns are moved, preventing provider summaries from being sent as model-generated reasoning.

### Fixed

- Fixed unconfigured judge roles incorrectly falling back to a Google Vertex Claude model instead of the configured `tiny`, `smol`, or `default` models.
- Fixed `omp --resume -p` continuing stale todos instead of printing the answer and exiting.
- Fixed `/btw`, IRC, and composer-prediction requests losing the conversation prompt cache on Codex and after thinking-level changes on GPT-6 models.
- Fixed Tern browser operations on `about:blank` and no-op navigations hanging until timeout.
- Fixed SDK and RPC sessions using stale MCP tool lists when servers changed during extension loading.
- Fixed installing plugins from non-GitHub Git URLs and prevented inline credentials from being persisted in plugin metadata or lockfiles.
- Improved recovery from repeated OpenAI Responses request timeouts during productive long-running sessions.
- Fixed JavaScript eval syntax errors lacking source location and a useful code frame.
- Fixed Collab sessions failing to reconnect after network interruptions or device sleep.
- Fixed ACP and browser diagnostics and SSH listings using default paths instead of configured paths.
- Fixed advisors repeatedly returning to models that refused reviewed content; they now remain on the fallback until the conversation changes state.
- Plugin registry discovery warnings are now reported instead of silently ignored.
- Fixed OpenRouter Decisions judge requests through custom provider base URLs returning 404 errors.
- Fixed Codex configuration files being rejected and prevented supported settings from being ignored.
- Fixed secrets appearing in advisor previews when a preview was truncated.
- Restored public compatibility exports required by tools, legacy Pi extensions, and plugins.
- Fixed slow completions ignoring explicitly configured thinking levels, including `:max` and `:off`.
- Fixed session writes failing on Windows FSLogix profile disks.
- Limited persisted eval status history so long-running eval cells do not excessively enlarge session files or slow resume.
- Fixed Codex session prewarming from using a different model or service tier than the resolved session.
- Fixed subagent completion-probe usage disappearing after parking or restarting.
- Fixed Python eval processes hanging while waiting on the kernel control channel.
- Corrected the custom-tool quickstart to use the supported discovery flow and shipped example.
- Fixed browser screenshots providing incorrect coordinate-scaling guidance on high-device-scale displays.
- Fixed browser calls hanging when a tab renderer crashed; they now fail promptly and reload or close the affected tab as appropriate.
- Fixed sessions becoming permanently busy when retry-related session writes failed.
- Fixed collapsed todo lists wasting a row on the hidden-item indicator.
- Fixed concurrent SDK sessions interfering with one another's async jobs and subagent follow-up results.
- Fixed duplicate accessibility-tree output from computer-use eval cells.
- Fixed chained element actions such as `win.ref("e5").click()` throwing errors; element interaction options are now supported and documented.
- Fixed JavaScript and Python `read("artifact://N")` calls returning a capped preview instead of the artifact's selected text.
- Improved guidance for retrieving complete lines when `read`, `eval`, or `bash` output is truncated by the column limit.
- Fixed resumed, switched, and forked sessions losing the prompt cache when Mnemopi or Hindsight auto-recall was enabled.
- Fixed the first prompt losing provider prompt-cache coverage while MCP servers were still starting.
- Fixed coordinate clicks being dropped after password-form submission in omp-launched Chromium.
- Fixed classifier refusals ending fallback chains prematurely when the retry budget was exhausted.
- Fixed reading MCP-advertised `skill://` resources and other MCP resources, including discovery order, loading state, and clean shutdown of stalled servers.
- Fixed smart unexpected-stop detection missing slow judge results, allowing premature stops to recover correctly.
- The `cfg://` settings approval prompt now honors `ask.timeout` rather than always expiring after ten seconds.
- Fixed custom LiteLLM providers not receiving the built-in provider behavior and model/session handling.
- Fixed resumed Cursor sessions losing earlier reasoning after transcript truncation.
- Fixed `computer.window()` failing to find windows by ID or application when many windows were open.
- Fixed `grep` hiding matches that appeared beyond the first 512 bytes of a long line.
- Fixed snapcompaction leaving too little context room after compaction.
- Fixed usage-limited account pools redeeming saved resets for accounts outside the configured pool.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-mnemopi

### Added

- Exported `clipRecallContent` for applications that need to format content consistently with Mnemopi recall previews.

### Fixed

- Fixed memory-save performance degradation and excessive memory-database growth when date-related terms such as “today” appeared in otherwise unrelated memories.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Added

- Added `applyBinaryPatch(oldPath, patchPath, outPath)` for applying HDiffPatch single-stream delta patches, including zstd-compressed patches, to files.
- macOS desktop sessions now keep the display awake while in use and expose screen-lock and display-sleep state through capabilities, `screenState`, and screen captures.

### Changed

- Improved Linux embedded-shell startup performance for external commands.
- Improved macOS computer-use performance, including faster screenshots and accessibility queries, with better handling of large numbers of off-screen windows.
- Updated `grep()` and `search()` to truncate matching lines around the first match when they exceed `maxColumns`, mark truncated sides with `...`, and report the match's character column.

### Fixed

- Fixed macOS accessibility and window-management operations requiring Screen Recording permission; only screenshots and display listing now require that permission, and window listing includes windows beyond the frontmost 48. Window titles from other applications remain unavailable without Screen Recording permission.
- Fixed macOS menu inspection and selection for menus containing items whose titles cannot be read; those items are now skipped safely.
- Fixed syntax highlighting and language detection for several languages, including TOML, PowerShell, SCSS, Less, Vim script, GraphQL, Protobuf, Terraform/HCL, Dockerfile, CMake, INI, gitignore, Kotlin, Swift, Elixir, Sass, Python f-strings, Julia interpolations, and Elixir interpolations.

## @oh-my-pi/omp-stats

### Fixed

- Fixed the stats dashboard favicon so dashboard tabs and bookmarks display the OMP icon correctly.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Added

- Added opt-in JSON editing for free-form array settings while keeping credential values masked; settings editors now surface submission and validation errors.
- Added ghost-text predictions to the editor via the new `Editor.prediction` callback. Press Tab or Right at the end of a line to accept the suggested text without submitting.
- Expanded table-chart support with stacked, waterfall, timeline, dots, range, slope, butterfly, bullet, ladder, histogram, and stat charts, including error whiskers, share bars, status matrices, and richer before/after visualizations.
- Added richer table-chart planning and presentation controls, including titles, ordering, grouping, shading, normalization, reference lines, polarity, rivals, focus rows, and model-driven selection for smart mode. Charts now identify key findings, highlight best values and changes, and adapt scales and labels for clearer comparisons.
- Added the optional `assistantMessageText` theme token for coloring assistant reply prose while preserving the terminal default when unset or empty.
- Added optional status-line support for showing saved usage resets that expire soon and warning once per conversation when a reset expires within 24 hours.

### Changed

- Improved table-chart planning to prefer waterfall charts over share bars for complex data sets and enforce segment limits for share-chart legibility
- Reduced the time required to rebuild long sessions on resume, particularly sessions with repeated wait polls or todo updates.
- Output summaries now identify the first and last lines omitted by column limits, and truncation notices point to the `:raw` selector for retrieving complete lines.

### Fixed

- Fixed session model selection and setup displaying role chips for roles that resolve to a non-chat runner rather than the model used by the session.
- Improved table-chart parsing and rendering across repeated labels, grouped and paired values, percentages, units, currency, durations, model sizes, links, identifiers, and sparse or side-by-side tables. Charts now avoid duplicate or misleading plots and preserve meaningful comparisons.
- Fixed table-chart scaling for outliers, stacked groups, zeros, logarithmic shading, and values spanning multiple orders of magnitude.
- Fixed `/tree` stalling or using excessive memory when opened on long sessions with many branch points.
- Fixed extension status messages losing SGR colors and text styles in the status line.
- Fixed the eval status list omitting status events discarded from long-running cells.
- Fixed loop-blocked diagnostics to attribute stalls to the correct work phase or terminal writes instead of reporting misleading unknown causes.
- Fixed Agent Hub and status-line spending totals losing cumulative subagent costs after compaction, parking, or follow-up turns.
- Fixed dead-key input on older Windows Terminal versions so quotes are entered correctly with Space, Enter, and Tab.
- Fixed SIXEL graphics detection on terminals, including native Windows Terminal, so SVG figures and inline images work without forcing a graphics protocol.
- Fixed overflow transcript rendering so user messages no longer appear as blank padding bars or leave stray prompt markers across terminal rows.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-utils

### Breaking Changes

- Renamed `takeRecentLoopPhase()` to `takeLoopPhaseAttribution()`. The new API returns a `LoopPhaseAttribution` object (`{ label, ms }`) and reports a label only when it accounts for more time than unlabeled work within an armed measurement window.

### Added

- Added `withLoopPhase(label, fn)` for attributing synchronous work to a named loop phase, with automatic cleanup even when the callback throws.

### Changed

- Improved streaming JSON parsing performance for long tool-argument payloads.

### Fixed

- Fixed archive extraction on Windows systems without symlink privileges by allowing symlink entries to be extracted using supported fallbacks, while skipping unresolvable dangling links instead of failing the entire archive.


## What's Changed
* feat(settings): expose extra context filenames in the TUI by @Shadorain in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15252
* feat(coding-agent): expose /annotate to extensions as ctx.annotations by @Shadorain in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15260
* perf(tui): bound linear session tree projection by @azain47 in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12527
* perf(tui): drop redundant full passes from transcript block removal by @sjawhar in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/13767
* perf(utils): bulk-skip ordinary chars in streaming JSON string scan by @abilliontokens in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14297
* feat(natives): speed up external command launches in the embedded shell by @farnoy in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14858
* fix(sdk): refresh changed MCP tools before returning the session by @aktanazat in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/11315
* fix(ai): keep closed summary parts and completed custom input on lossy Responses streams by @moodiness in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/11863
* fix(tui): stop /tree from exhausting memory on long sessions by @ParadaCarleton in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12622
* fix: re-arm Responses request-body timeout recovery on turn output by @hellofrommorgan in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12654
* fix(coding-agent): report cell line and column with a code frame for JS eval syntax errors by @tahakotil in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14376
* fix(collab): reconnect a relay socket that went silent by @andrewleech in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14387
* fix(tui): keep SGR styling in extension hook statuses by @sandboiii in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14500
* fix(coding-agent): show resolved diagnostic and SSH config paths by @Dante-dan in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14558

name: v18.8.9
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Changed

- Updated state field rendering to trim trailing whitespace and normalize empty collection formatting for consistent prompt output

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- Added capability-driven extension terminal launches for tmux, Zellij, Herdr, and CMUX, with consolidated multiplexer detection, provider/shell capability feedback, and required POSIX-shell confirmation for shell-input launches; CMUX shell input preserves non-ASCII arguments and pane working directories ([#13620](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/13620) by [@anatoli-tsinovoy](https://github.com/anatoli-tsinovoy)).
- Added `/fork pane|window|tab` to open a fork of the session in a new multiplexer pane or window while this session keeps running; bare `/fork` still forks in place ([#13620](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/13620) by [@anatoli-tsinovoy](https://github.com/anatoli-tsinovoy)).
- Added Orca CLI-based launches for `/fork pane|window|tab` and `ctx.ui.openTerminal()`, with POSIX-shell confirmation; when Orca can only start a tab as a background terminal, the launch reports a warning instead of a visible tab ([#13620](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/13620) by [@anatoli-tsinovoy](https://github.com/anatoli-tsinovoy)).

### Changed

- CLI `--fork` now pairs tool calls the source session left unresolved with an unknown-outcome result, and `/tan` clones report such calls as unknown-outcome instead of aborted; forking a source whose process already exited keeps the process-exit recovery and pending-tool warning ([#13620](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/13620) by [@anatoli-tsinovoy](https://github.com/anatoli-tsinovoy)).
- Table charts (`tui.autoGraph`) now cover before/after tables whose rows are different metrics (time, memory, counts): each row's change is drawn as a factor of its "before" value (`48× less`, `+27%`), and rows written in prose are skipped and named under the chart. A single column of scores like `12/12` is drawn as bars filling toward 100%
- In terminals that speak the Tern Surface Protocol (Tern), the composer's bottom bar shows the git branch and its status beside the model chip when the status line has the `git` segment; it outlasts the other facts as the bar narrows, and clicking it opens `/git` ([#15220](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15220) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Table charts plot scores like `154/160` as the share of their total instead of the first number, and tables comparing two or three columns across four or more metrics now get a chart: a grid of one small panel per metric

### Fixed

- Fixed table charts failing on a table cell such as `3 constructor` or `2 valueOf calls`

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Breaking Changes

- Removed the `isInsideTmux()`, `isInsideZellij()`, and `isInsideHerdr()` exports; use `hasTerminalMultiplexerSession("tmux" | "zellij" | "herdr", env)` instead ([#13620](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/13620) by [@anatoli-tsinovoy](https://github.com/anatoli-tsinovoy))

### Added

- `classifyTerminalMultiplexer()` reports `"orca"` inside Orca terminals while `isInsideTerminalMultiplexer()` stays false there, so Orca keeps the direct-terminal render path; `TERMINAL_MULTIPLEXER_ENV_KEYS` lists every environment variable multiplexer detection reads ([#13620](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/13620) by [@anatoli-tsinovoy](https://github.com/anatoli-tsinovoy))
- Added `terminalMultiplexerSessions()`, `terminalMultiplexerForTerm()`, `classifyTerminalMultiplexerModule()`, and `routeTerminalMultiplexerNotification()`, driven by one multiplexer registry that now owns notification routing and per-multiplexer capability overrides ([#13620](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/13620) by [@anatoli-tsinovoy](https://github.com/anatoli-tsinovoy))
- Added `change` and `progress` table-chart kinds with `ChartSpec.baseline` and `TableColumn.scores`: a before/after table whose rows have their own units charts each metric as a factor of the baseline column (rows without two numbers are named in the caption), and `analyzeTable` reads whole-number scores (`12/12`, `154/160`) as the percent of their total, keeping `a / b` pairs and lists as written

### Changed

- `StatusLineComponent.describeComposerFacts()` includes the configured `git` segment among the composer's facts (branch and status, the `status.git` click action, pinned so it outlasts the other facts) instead of leaving the branch to Tern's pane header ([#15220](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15220) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Small-multiple table charts with more than three panels and at most six categories draw as bands of per-metric panels with a color legend, and `worthCharting` counts their panels like categories
- Table charts take the look of Apple's charts and Tern: a UI sans, hairline gridlines, rounded bars and cells, smooth lines over a soft area fill, dot legends, left-aligned category labels that never run off the edge, and axes labeled in one unit (`0, 5k, 10k`)
- Line charts whose series differ 8× or more in size stack panels on their own axes instead of flattening the smaller lines, and their end labels no longer overlap
- SVG figure series colors `--c1`…`--c6` are an even-weight palette led by the theme accent's hue instead of syntax colors

### Fixed

- Fixed `parseCell` throwing on table cells such as `3 constructor` or `2 valueOf calls`, and reading a `constructor` cell as a missing value

## @oh-my-pi/pi-utils

### Added

- Added `hueDistance`, the angular distance between two OKLCH hues


## What's Changed
* feat(tui): show the git branch in Tern's composer bar by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15220
* feat(coding-agent): add multiplexer terminal launch and /fork placements by @anatoli-tsinovoy in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/13620


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/compare/v18.8.8...v18.8.9

name: v18.8.8
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

### Added

- Added `Agent.setModelResolver()` to fit every model an agent adopts (via `setModel`, starting with the current one) before it is used ([#15048](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15048) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Added `CompactionSettings.baseWindowTokens`: when set, `resolveThresholdTokens()` scales its percentage or reserve-based threshold from that base instead of the full context window ([#15065](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15065) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

### Fixed

- Fixed OpenAI V1 remote compaction re-attaching a prior Anthropic native payload after a successful compact ([#15041](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15041) by [@PaleRoses](https://github.com/PaleRoses))
- Fixed `resolveThresholdTokens()` clamping a positive `thresholdTokens` to `baseWindowTokens`; a fixed threshold is checked against the real window, and the base only rescales the percentage and reserve policies ([#15074](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15074) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed `resolveThresholdTokens()` clamping a fixed `thresholdTokens` at or past the context window to one token below it, so compaction fired only after the next request overflowed; it now clamps to the window less the reserve ([#15146](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15146) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Fixed

- Fixed OpenAI Responses and Codex tool calls running with empty `{}` arguments when a compatible host or proxy ends the call with an empty arguments payload after streaming the real ones ([#15099](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15099) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed truncated Factory Droid Gemini responses ending as a hard error or a half-received tool call instead of being retried ([#15103](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15103) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed Factory Droid Gemini ignoring an error the server reports mid-response, which hid its status and retried errors that cannot succeed ([#15103](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15103) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed resumed OpenAI Responses sessions (xAI, Factory Droid, OpenAI and other hosts) dropping all earlier encrypted reasoning on their first request; GitHub Copilot still rebuilds history until its first response ([#15148](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15148) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

## @oh-my-pi/browser-relay

### Fixed

- Fixed tabs a relay client asks to open in the background being created as the selected tab ([#15109](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15109) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Added

- Added the `connection-bound-native-history` rule axis for Responses hosts that reject native history items from an earlier connection, set for GitHub Copilot ([#15148](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15148) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

### Fixed

- Fixed Devin's discovered models not marking the account's default model, the one Devin's own CLI starts the account on (SWE-2 High on Pro, SWE-1.6 Slow on Free); when it is an effort lane of a family, the family starts at that effort. Cursor's discovered models no longer carry that marker, so Cursor keeps its existing startup selection ([#15115](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15115) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- Added `/jobs kill <id>|all` to cancel a running background job (or every one this session owns) from the command line, even while the agent is busy ([#14160](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14160) by [@KanwarGill](https://github.com/KanwarGill))
- Added `omp anonymize [session] [-o dir]` to write a shareable copy of a session and its subagent transcripts: only an explicit allowlist of omp metadata (ids, timestamps, models, usage, built-in tool names and options) is kept; message, thinking, and tool-output text become size-annotated `[redacted …]` markers; tool-call paths become mock paths (`/home/seg3/seg4/src/seg9.ts:10-20`), shell commands keep known programs and flags, other literals such as a grep pattern become `PLACEHOLDER_N`, and extension or MCP payloads are redacted whole, with the same original always mapping to the same token across files ([#15077](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15077) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Added `/dump anon`, which writes the same anonymized session and subagent JSONL to a zip in the temp directory and copies its path ([#15077](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15077) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Added message times to `/dump` transcripts (assistant turns also show request duration and time to first token), and live status, last activity, pending tool calls, and the partially streamed turn to `/dump all` files for subagents still running, so a stuck subagent can be diagnosed from the archive ([#15121](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15121) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Added `contextFiles.extra` to load extra instruction files, such as `AGENTS.local.md`, beside the usual context file ([#15147](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15147) by [@Shadorain](https://github.com/Shadorain)).
- `/annotate` opens the note you are writing, a file or typed-prompt source, or (for local diff reviews) the current working-tree file in `$VISUAL` or `$EDITOR` with the external-editor key (Ctrl+G by default); a file source is saved back and its notes follow the edited text ([#15151](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15151) by [@Shadorain](https://github.com/Shadorain))

### Changed

- A `/models` compaction limit set past a model's standard context window now runs that model on its extended window instead of being silently clamped; the hub warns (noting long-context pricing) and saves on a second Enter, in the terminal and in Tern, and rejects limits past the model's largest window ([#15048](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15048) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- A token compaction limit set in `/models` (or `compaction.modelThresholds`) is now the base omp scales with its usual policy, as if it were the model's window (85% of it by default for bases above ~109k, or `compaction.thresholdPercent` of it), instead of the exact point. Plain numbers saved since 18.8.5 therefore compact earlier; rewrite one as `"f<tokens>"` (or type `f400k` in the hub) to keep it an exact trigger. The `/models` limit field shows where the model would compact as you type (`compacts at 340K · 85% of 400K base`), the preview's **Compacts at** row says why, and the saved message repeats it ([#15065](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15065) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

### Fixed

- Fixed `/usage` (or clicking the status-line cost) while the usage dashboard was already open stacking a second dashboard on top; it now focuses the open one ([#15145](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15145) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed the browser tool prompt not documenting `observe()`'s `viewportOnly` and `includeAll` options, or that `open`/`close`/`run` timeouts are seconds clamped to 1–300 while `waitFor*` timeouts are milliseconds ([#15104](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15104) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed browser relay pages opened in the background (`browser.newPage({ background: true })` in `tab.run`) taking over the user's selected tab; they now open unselected once the relay extension is reinstalled ([#15109](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15109) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed browser `open` with `app.relay` and a `target` failing with `No page target matched` or `Selected tab is no longer available` when the matching tab was opened a moment earlier outside omp; it now waits briefly for the relay to list the tab ([#15112](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15112) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed a timed-out `browser.open` holding up the next open of the same browser (apps launched with `app.path` excepted) until its abandoned launch or connect returned; the timeout error now names the step that stalled ([#15117](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15117) by [@jinpyo-jeon](https://github.com/jinpyo-jeon) and [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed browser tabs crashing mid-load on some pages with a same-site iframe, Google Travel among them, after which every open, screenshot and evaluate on the tab timed out ([#15118](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15118) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed the custom-tool examples' full-documentation link opening a missing page ([#15076](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15076) by [@qingshungLI](https://github.com/qingshungLI))
- Fixed the `/models` compaction limit preview and **Compacts at** row rounding fractional percentages (`12.5%` showed as `13%`) ([#15074](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15074) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed `/omfg` save, overwrite, and validation prompts in Tern opening as a sheet over the candidate rule; they now sit in the composer slot like `ask`, so the rule stays readable while you choose ([#15058](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15058) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed hotkeys pressed in Tern while omp is still starting (such as Alt+P for the model selector) being ignored; like in other terminals, they now take effect once startup finishes ([#15120](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15120) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed a startup extension dialog (select, confirm, input) in Tern not receiving keys until it timed out ([#15122](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15122) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed auto-compaction overflowing the context window every cycle when `compaction.thresholdTokens` or an `f<tokens>` model limit is at or past a window the provider caps lower (such as Factory's 196K Kimi K3); it now compacts at the window less the reserve, and `/models` shows the trigger as capped ([#15146](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15146) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed resumed xAI, Factory Droid and OpenAI sessions forgetting earlier reasoning on their first request, while a retry after a stale Responses item error still rebuilds history ([#15148](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15148) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed the startup default ignoring the model a provider's discovery names as the account's default: with no model chosen, Devin Pro now starts on SWE-2 at High instead of SWE-1.6 ([#15115](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15115) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-mnemopi

### Fixed

- Fixed long retained transcripts exhausting local memory extraction models by limiting each extraction input to 8192 characters while keeping the opening context and newest turns ([#14956](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/14956)).

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Changed

- Reduced macOS accessibility-tree latency for `ax()` without changing its text output: each element's children are read once, and its bounds, which the tree never shows, are no longer read ([#15159](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15159) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

### Fixed

- Fixed macOS computer use reporting `AxFailed` instead of `StaleRef` for a ref whose element the app had removed ([#15156](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15156) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed macOS `el.press()` and `el.perform()` reporting `AxFailed` when the app did not answer in time, such as a press that opens a modal dialog; they now report `AxUnconfirmed` ([#15156](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15156) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Breaking Changes

- `ModelHubCallbacks.onCompactionPointChange` now receives a `confirmed` flag and returns a `CompactionPointChangeResult` (`{ kind: "error" }` or `{ kind: "confirm" }`) instead of an error string; a `confirm` result shows a warning that a second Enter on the same input accepts ([#15048](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15048) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- `ModelCompactionPoint.percent` is replaced by `basis`, a short explanation of why the model compacts there (`fixed`, `85% of 400K base`, `80% of window`) that the model hub preview shows next to the trigger ([#15065](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15065) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

### Added

- Added an `inline` option to `HookSelectorComponent` that keeps a selector in the composer slot in Tern instead of opening it as a sheet over the screen ([#15058](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15058) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Added `ModelHubCallbacks.previewCompactionPoint`, whose line the compaction limit field shows while you type instead of the input syntax ([#15065](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15065) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Added Vim find and till motions (`f`, `F`, `t`, `T`) in the prompt editor, with `;` and `,` to repeat them ([#15100](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15100) by [@Shadorain](https://github.com/Shadorain))
- Added Vim replace (`r`, `R`) in the prompt editor ([#15100](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15100) by [@Shadorain](https://github.com/Shadorain))
- Added Vim bracket and quote matching (`%`), paragraph motions (`{`, `}`), line join (`J`), and indent (`>>`, `<<`) in the prompt editor ([#15100](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15100) by [@Shadorain](https://github.com/Shadorain))
- Added an external-editor key (Ctrl+G by default) to the annotation overlay for the note draft and, when the host provides `onExternalEditor`, the source being annotated; an edited text source is returned as `editedText` on the paste result ([#15151](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15151) by [@Shadorain](https://github.com/Shadorain))
- Added `TUI.releaseHeldInput()`: on a terminal expected to speak TSP, a `deferInput` start now holds keystrokes (TSP events and the cell-size reply still apply; Ctrl+C/Ctrl+D release early) until the app calls it once its session is wired; such terminals also skip the sixel probe ([#15120](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15120) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Added `TUI.replaceHeldFocus(previous, next)`, which `Composer.setEditor()` calls so a swapped-in editor inherits held startup keys; only keys for the start-time focus owner are now held, and a dialog that takes focus gets its input live ([#15122](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15122) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Added `RenderResultOptions.elapsedMs` and `cancelled`, `NativeToolHead.command` and `NativeToolView.preview: "children"` for native describe hooks

### Changed

- Tern draws each bash run, eval cell and `!`/`$` run as one box: the command or code, its output, status lines and a foot with state, time and facts; images sit below the box and the bash head shows the intent instead of the command

### Fixed

- Fixed the Agents hub Time column rewinding and freezing for running subagents between progress updates ([#15140](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15140) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-utils

### Fixed

- Fixed `formatDuration` printing `60.0s` for durations just under a minute; they now read `1m` ([#15121](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15121) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-wire

### Added

- Added `TspToolProps.command` (the command line Copy command copies), `TspToolProps.preview: "children"` (the collapsed body stays whole while its children clamp) and `TspCodeProps.preview`


## What's Changed
* fix(tui): keep /omfg prompts in the Tern composer slot by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15058
* feat(coding-agent): let custom compaction limits reach the extended context window by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15048
* feat(coding-agent): scale per-model compaction limits, add a fixed mode, and explain them in the hub by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15065
* fix(coding-agent): address review follow-ups on per-model compaction limits by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15074
* fix(docs): correct custom tool guide link by @qingshungLI in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15076
* fix(agent): keep cleaned preserve data after V1 remote compaction by @PaleRoses in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15041
* fix(mnemopi): bound retained transcript extraction input by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14959
* feat(coding-agent): add /jobs kill <id>|all by @KanwarGill in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14160
* feat(coding-agent): add session anonymizer (omp anonymize, /dump anon) by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15077
* fix(tui): queue input during startup in Tern by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15120
* feat(tui): add the missing Vim editing keys by @Shadorain in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15100
* fix(tui): exit history on vim replace overwrite and keep counted r linear by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15127
* fix(coding-agent): show live subagent state and message times in /dump by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15121
* fix(tui): deliver Tern startup dialog input live and replay held keys before draft restore by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15122
* fix(tui): keep agent hub Time ticking forward between subagent progress frames by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15140
* fix(coding-agent): focus the open /usage dashboard instead of stacking another by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15145

name: Reasonix Studio v2.35.0
body:
本版加入 Linux 的 rpm 安装包、MCP 工具定义固定与变更扣留、闲置会话自动归档、硬件加速开关和反馈回复通知，并修复信任库无限增长、新会话默认模型被跳过时无提示等问题。

## 新增

- 新增 Linux 的 `.rpm` 安装包（`ReasonixStudio-linux-*.rpm`），本版是首个含 rpm 的版本；用 minisign 校验，无 GPG 签名；rpm 安装的版本暂不自动更新 (#12608)
- MCP 工具定义在你批准时被固定：之后有变化或新增的工具会被扣住，不进入模型请求，调用会被明确拒绝，直到用 `reasonix mcp trust <名称> --digest <摘要>` 批准；桌面端目前只显示通知 (#12597)
- 设置的外观页新增「图形」：可关闭硬件加速（下次启动生效），并显示当前窗口的绘制方式；窗口无法绘制时，可用环境变量 `REASONIX_DISABLE_GPU=1` 或参数 `--disable-gpu` 仅关闭这一次 (#12451)
- 设置新增可选的闲置会话自动归档（默认关闭，默认 30 天，范围 1 到 3650）；已置顶、正在运行、有待回答事项或有未读完成的会话不会被归档，归档可恢复 (#11535)
- 反馈的未读角标在应用打开期间自动刷新，窗口不在前台时有新回复会弹出通知；通知设置里新增「反馈有回复时」开关，在总开关打开时默认开启 (#11538)
- 设置的「关于」页新增「支持项目」入口，含 PayPal 链接以及默认折叠的微信、支付宝收款码 (#11709)

## 变更

- 提交接口 `POST /submit` 只在提交确实被丢弃时返回 409；已受理并立刻结束的回合、排在结束中回合之后的提交现在返回 202 (#12596)
- 电脑操作返回给模型的应用名和窗口标题现在限长并转义，包含换行或不可见字符的名称不再能伪造快照行 (#12585)
- 安装 skill 或本地插件时，复制的来源若是指向目录的别名现在可以安装；批准之后来源别名被改指向别处，会被拒绝而不会复制 (#12112 by @KHG420)

## 修复

- 信任库 `trusted/` 目录不再无限增长：密封记录不再把合同的验收条目复制进每一回合，义务清单改为只存一份并按摘要引用 (#12609, Fixes #12603 fixed in #12609)
- 新会话的默认模型是决策来源而被跳过时，终端界面和 `reasonix run` 现在给出「默认模型不可用」的通知，不再静默改用别的模型 (#12605 by @xxoingr)

## 贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@KHG420、@xxoingr

## What's Changed
* test(serve): wait for a trace turn to go silent, not for a fixed time by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12599
* fix(repolint): wire-parity reads embedded structs and extends, declares PermissionRules by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12590
* perf(gitcmd): skip the driver listing for subcommands that cannot run a driver by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12588
* fix(computer): bound and escape application names in the snapshot and app list by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12585
* fix(serve): judge POST /submit by what admission did with it by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12596
* feat(studio): opt-in archiving of conversations inactive for N days by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/11535
* fix(config): report a skipped default on the new-session path too by @xxoingr in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12605
* feat(studio): switch hardware acceleration off and show how the window is drawn by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12451
* feat(release): build and publish an rpm of Studio for Linux by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12608
* feat(feedback): refresh the unread badge while open and announce new replies by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/11538
* feat(studio): add a Support entry to Settings > About by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/11709
* fix(installsource): copy directory root aliases by @KHG420 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12112
* fix(agent): stop copying the contract's criteria into every sealed bundle by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12609
* feat(plugin): pin MCP tool definitions at approval and hold changed tools by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12597
* docs(release): Studio 2.35.0 notes by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12610


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/compare/studio-v2.34.0...studio-v2.35.0


---

**macOS** 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。**Windows** 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。**Linux** Debian 系从 `.deb` 安装，Fedora、RHEL、openSUSE 等从 `.rpm` 安装（`sudo dnf install ./ReasonixStudio-linux-amd64.rpm`）。

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 的 `.deb` 走自己的包（`.rpm` 的自更新尚未提供，请手动下载新包），Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。

name: Reasonix Studio v2.34.0
body:
本版让输入框可以直接切换工作区的本地分支，界面缩放改用统一范围并支持 Ctrl/Cmd +/-/0，电脑操作能判断每一步是否生效，并修复回退冲突、旧版会话导入、模型切换、GLM 思考参数和多处终端界面的问题。

## 新增

- 输入框的分支标签读取真实的 git 状态，并可直接把工作区切换到另一个本地分支；有进行中的回合、后台任务或未提交改动时会明确拒绝并说明原因 (#12092 by @XTLine, #12171 by @XTLine)
- 界面缩放只有一个声明范围 0.8 到 1.8（步长 0.05），滑块显示的值就是实际保存的值，并可用 Ctrl/Cmd 加 `+`、`-`、`0` 调整 (#12035)
- 电脑操作的每一步会标明效果是否可信，并带上占住输入的模态对话框；Windows 上输入文字会读回确认，被错误框挡住时不再假装成功 (#12541, #12542)
- 自动压缩因上次摘要失败而被暂缓时，界面和终端界面会显示一条中英文提示，不再静默 (#12083)
- 终端界面输入框为空时按回车，回到最新输出并继续跟随，与 1.x 一致；`Ctrl+Z` 把终端界面挂起到命令行，`fg` 后恢复 (#12510 by @xxoingr, #12511 by @xxoingr)
- 思考参数面板按协议声明的字段命名，Responses 协议的服务商不再显示成只支持 Chat (#12498)

## 变更

- 侧栏底部的用量、反馈、账号和设置，在图标栏可见时不再重复显示；图标栏隐藏、仅折叠时显示或窄窗口下仍保留 (#12482 by @SivanCola)
- 显式声明 `glm` 协议的服务，glm-5.2、glm-5.3、glm-5.3-flash 的请求现在带 `reasoning_effort`：5.2 选 high 真发 high，选 none 真关思考；5.3 的「关闭」发 `thinking=enabled` 加 low (#12552)
- 决策来源不再出现在输入框的模型切换器里，选它会得到明确错误，而不是不可预期的失败 (#12553)
- 已保存的决策来源点「测试连接」时，改走它自己的协议并给出分类错误，不再提示「加 /v1」 (#12546)
- 配置编辑锁目录改放在用户主目录下，遇到属于他人的目录时给出明确错误，不再报一个裸的权限错误 (#11374 by @drakeo338)
- 权限规则写成不对应任何已注册工具的裸命令（如 `ask = ["rm"]`）时会被报告并拒绝，不再静默失效 (#12536)
- 安装计划里来自软件包的文字（版本、名称、路径、警告等）现在限长并清除控制字符，`.mcp.json` 声明的服务数超限会被拒绝 (#12037, #12512 by @xxoingr)

## 修复

- 代码回退之后再次回退同一回合或更早的回合，不再误报文件冲突；回退确认里的文件数按整个回退范围统计 (#11572 by @Guan0923, #11692 by @Guan0923)
- 打开 1.x 会话时不再多出一份同名副本 (#12506)
- 导入 1.x 目录时，读不了的会话会逐条列出并附带原因，不再只给一个警告数量 (#12538)
- 模型切换被拒时区分是回合仍在运行还是只剩后台任务，并说明各自的处理办法 (#12505)
- 模型切换后，已接入的拦截器类扩展不再失效，也不再误报其服务已停止 (#12367 by @KHG420)
- Windows 上通过注册表里的安装路径找到 Git Bash，回退到 PowerShell 时明确告知；外壳探测有时限且结果会保存，不再拖慢启动 (#12486, #12539)
- Git 低于 2.31 时，工作区不再被误判为「不是仓库」而丢失状态、提交和分支标签 (#12518)
- 压缩摘要因输出上限被截断时，自动用加倍的上限重试一次 (#12469)
- 计划模式拒绝调用时，说明被拒的命令、原因类别和可行的出路 (#12517)
- 本回合只改了 `.md`/`.rst` 文档时，不再被要求运行验证命令 (#12520)
- 交付卡片不再把主机自己的任务快照、工具缓存和 `.git` 当作改动，也不再给中文用户显示英文句子 (#12465)
- 后台任务完成、终止、失败的提示改为按界面语言显示 (#12476)
- 提问卡片的自由文字输入框始终可见，运行状态明确写为等待你的回答 (#12540)
- 图标栏的悬停提示不再被裁掉或被遮住 (#12468)
- 重写已发送消息的输入框与队列行的编辑框随文字长度调整高度，长段落不再只露出两行 (#12477)
- 记忆页保存时，较新的草稿不会被先前的保存完成而清掉，各条记忆的写入按钮分别保持禁用 (#12135 by @KHG420)
- 切换设置里的连接后，软件包安装表单和更新锁不再沿用上一个连接的内容 (#12126 by @KHG420)
- 技能安装和注册的结果只报告所选来源自己的文件，同名技能被遮蔽时给出警告，目录别名也会被跟随 (#12107 by @KHG420, #12109 by @KHG420, #12110 by @KHG420)
- `memory` 工具的搜索和列表在丢弃结果时会注明丢了多少条，模型不再把截断当作完整 (#12104 by @chuiwenwei)
- 宿主日志不再被例行请求刷满，内核异常退出时留下可读的崩溃记录 (#12523)

## 贡献者

**macOS** 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。**Windows** 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。**Linux** 从 `.deb` 安装。
