name: openclaw 2026.10.5-beta.1
body:
## 2026.10.5-beta.1

### Highlights

- **Safer updates:** updates finish across devices, filesystems, Windows elevation, and interrupted activations, and recover from stale leases or changed evidence instead of stranding the install or blocking future updates. (#164636, #164769, #165257, #165863, #166548, #166695, #168043, #166394, #167302) Thanks @hrp6vv9mwr-glitch, @MrJanvar, @Shirleyyyhk, @farisoftfry, @neilofneils404, and @shanselman.
- **Restart-safe conversations:** interrupted turns, first messages during worktree preparation, and deferred tasks resume after a Gateway restart, and user input and committed session data survive restarts, concurrent writes, and failed publications. (#165333, #166042, #165184, #166238, #165502, #167570, #163258, #166010, #167662) Thanks @masatohoshino, @goutamadwant, and @hawkit.
- **Faster, steadier Gateway:** session, transcript, history, and metadata reads move onto worker threads with far less SQLite work per turn, and startup maintenance runs after readiness so busy Gateways stay responsive. (#164744, #165470, #165614, #166587, #167194, #164779, #165028, #166041, #167278, #165993) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Reliable turns and subagents:** turns recover from stalled streams, reused tool-call IDs, and expired ChatGPT websockets, incomplete turns end with a visible notice, and subagent results keep returning through follow-ups, restarts, and expired delivery windows. (#165983, #167013, #165212, #167063, #167972, #164282, #168068, #166846, #166139, #165987) Thanks @cestercian, @Irish-Joseph, @rmyers64, @sszyh2026, @Jackten, @Oldrich333, @obviyus, @stackingrockss, @Yun-0000, @michaeljgood71, and @LifeViwer.
- **X channel:** answer X (Twitter) mentions through a new channel plugin with streaming, guest mode for repository questions, and enforced API cost limits. (#165138, #165337, #165354, #165351)
- **Voice calls:** voice calls gain per-call briefs, call reports, live steering, callbacks, and voicemail detection. (#165716) Thanks @mbelinky and @jacobtomlinson.
- **Smarter model pickers:** pickers lead with each provider's recommended models, show newly listed Claude, ChatGPT, and Ollama models without waiting for an OpenClaw release, and stay responsive while catalogs load. (#167370, #166737, #167658, #167387, #167463, #165989) Thanks @obviyus, @DonnieFi, and @dprev.
- **ClawHub in the Gateway:** browse and search ClawHub plugins and skills from the Gateway, and plugins automatically pick the newest official release your OpenClaw supports. (#163459, #167485, #166588) Thanks @jacobtomlinson and @charlesBerg-ux.

### Changes

- **Sessions:** allow directed sends to a session without granting transcript access. (#164444)
- **Worker-local inference:** add a native worker inference runtime with Gateway dispatch, client placement, required worker policy and destination checks before local inference, and clear setup-failure explanations. (#158902, #163645, #163646, #163647, #166611, #166613, #165960) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Public threads:** open public threads at their regular links. (#166049)
- **Subagent progress:** count running subagents on the working line, name launched subagents in the operations group, and continue a resumed answer in the block that handed off. (#165477, #165725, #165542) Thanks @shakkernerd.
- **X channel:** add the X (Twitter) mentions channel plugin with Activity API streaming and backfill, repository-question guest mode with hidden same-agent helpers, GitHub-verified repository writers, and daily and monthly X API cost limits. (#165138, #165337, #165376, #165354, #165543, #168071, #165351) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Automation repair:** let a failing automation's owner conversation repair it before alerting, give a second repair turn when the error changes, and post a clear warning when a repair turn times out. (#161007, #162702, #162772) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Channel progress:** show useful Telegram and Discord progress by default, add per-tool glyphs to Discord progress drafts, restore per-tool emoji on Telegram tool rows, and hide routine Slack reaction rows. (#166861, #168032, #167392, #166880) Thanks @obviyus, @keshavbotagent, and @notmnp.
- **Skills:** keep learned skills focused on repeatable procedures rather than facts or codebase knowledge, and keep longer legacy Workshop skills manageable. (#167404, #167639) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Memory:** explain why trigger recall is skipped and why embedding responses are rejected, and report managed Ollama and LM Studio embedding readiness. (#164409, #168035, #156483) Thanks @Ayushdevo, @wangmiao0668000666, and @obviyus.
- **Models and catalogs:** show each provider's recommended models first in pickers, publish curated per-provider recommendations in catalog v2, lead NVIDIA recommendations with its featured models, and apply downloaded catalogs without a Gateway restart. (#167370, #166737, #167989, #158000) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Anthropic and Claude CLI:** support Claude Haiku 5.5, show newly listed Claude models without waiting for an OpenClaw release, list each Claude CLI model once, and keep logged-out Claude CLI models listed with a login reason. (#166706, #167658, #166311, #166338, #167942) Thanks @RomneyDa and @obviyus.
- **OpenAI:** support custom realtime voice endpoints, show account chat models missing from the manifest, surface new ChatGPT-login models without a release, and stop offering ChatGPT-only or bundled-Codex-rejected models that would fail. (#165632, #162563, #167387, #167633, #167975) Thanks @jacobtomlinson and @obviyus.
- **Tool rows and subagent progress:** show Tool Search calls in native tool rows with shared tool icons across clients, show the subagent wait in place without handoff markers, and guide users after HTTP 400 prompt-size rejections. (#165095, #165378, #159712) Thanks @shakkernerd and @sunlit-deng.
- **Voice calls:** add per-call briefs, call reports, live steering, callbacks, and voicemail detection to voice calls. (#165716) Thanks @mbelinky and @jacobtomlinson.
- **Control UI subagents:** show when a chat is waiting on subagents, open the Subagents panel from the chat's subagent count and names, and surface child failures and attention in the parent chat. (#164190, #166142, #166224, #166312, #166347) Thanks @shakkernerd and @vincentkoc.
- **Control UI customization:** let themes customize Control UI branding, use agent avatars or unlocked Lobsterdex icons for browser tabs, choose favicon shapes, and add seven Lobsterdex character variants. (#168027, #165201, #166325, #167809, #159815) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski, @jacobtomlinson, and @hannesrudolph.
- **Terminal:** add configurable terminal fonts with built-in Nerd Font icons. (#166180) Thanks @jacobtomlinson.
- **Control UI navigation:** copy file paths from chat tooltips, pin agents directly from the switcher, make agent menus easier to scan, let users hide a session's branch PR row, and simplify optional question cards. (#164431, #165640, #165641, #166366, #168040, #150587) Thanks @jjjhenriksen, @vyctorbrzezowski, and @RomneyDa.
- **Skill Workshop:** show each skill with its changes, files, and history in one view. (#167440) Thanks @obviyus.
- **iOS:** connect the Gateway through native Cloudflare Access with app-owned browser and profile admission. (#147244, #147238) Thanks @vincentkoc, @Solvely-Colin, @Patrick-Erichsen, and @RomneyDa.
- **ClawHub:** browse and search ClawHub plugins and skills through the Gateway. (#163459) Thanks @jacobtomlinson.
- **Plugins:** let plugin tools deliver their finished reply without a second model turn, allow every loaded plugin its own state and ingress queues and queue modes, and select plugin-owned self-hosted executors. (#164558, #165063, #165965, #161609) Thanks @mbelinky and @sjf-oa.
- **Plugins:** pick the newest official plugin release the running OpenClaw supports and keep a working plugin when its matching release is unavailable. (#167485, #166588) Thanks @charlesBerg-ux.
- **Workboard:** pin, unpin, and delete boards from the sidebar, keep card notes selectable with a roomier notes editor, and keep column edits on rename. (#165020, #166625, #167348) Thanks @rogeriochaves, @llmsommelier, and @obviyus.
- **GitHub:** support asynchronous PR merges and compact the Publish PR card. (#163579, #165219) Thanks @vincentkoc.
- **Session performance:** serve per-turn session projections, entry reads, authority checks, compaction reads, and first-turn headers from worker threads to keep the Gateway main thread responsive. (#164779, #165028, #165205, #165406, #165401, #165581, #165819, #165027, #165367, #164747, #164989, #165073)
- **Session list and search performance:** stop Control UI list refresh bursts, bound list materialization, scope and prefilter transcript search, speed up cold suggestion lists, and retain previews across metadata edits. (#162280, #164764, #165080, #165089, #165570, #165150, #165834, #165096, #165932, #166635, #165887, #167909)
- **Turn database performance:** reduce SQLite statements, worker requests, and redundant reads per chat turn, batch snapshot and metadata queries, and reuse admitted schema and reader facts. (#164490, #166041, #166053, #166054, #166074, #166102, #166541, #166503, #166519, #166698, #167278, #167686, #167685, #167690, #167932, #167046, #166966, #166925, #167291, #166703, #167029, #165360, #165193)
- **State database performance:** speed up cold agent database admission and crash recovery, reuse integrity checks on clean restarts, stop reopening executors when switching agents, and release leases promptly during shutdown. (#164846, #165070, #165186, #165293, #165680, #166112, #165993, #167001, #168008, #164788, #164962, #165085, #165910, #166822)
- **Maintenance and history performance:** lighten idle and manual maintenance, lifecycle cleanup, archive, reset, and trajectory retention work, and speed history reads with nested tool activity. (#164851, #164755, #164938, #165081, #165082, #165254, #165090, #165074, #165274, #165678, #167268, #167070, #167549, #167643, #168013, #167449, #165221, #165181, #165093, #165086, #165111, #165377, #165495, #165909, #166069, #166631, #166778, #166804, #167434, #167915, #167959) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen and @obviyus.
- **Agent performance:** reduce retained heap, per-turn prompt allocations, transcript reads, and main-thread SQLite work during runs, preserve prompt cache across instruction refreshes and image cleanup, and reuse verified history images across turns. (#167454, #167922, #167682, #167547, #167698, #167613, #167355, #167938, #165142, #165404, #167282, #164685, #165012, #165410, #165370, #165552) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Model catalog performance:** speed up multi-provider catalog refreshes, avoid discovery on cold account reads and unrequested plugin catalogs, retain account catalogs during refresh, and reduce catalog worker heap. (#167101, #167334, #167359, #167009, #167008, #166007, #166434, #165911, #165708, #165547, #165034, #165491, #166602) Thanks @vincentkoc, @obviyus, and @xialonglee.
- **Subagent and ACP performance:** reduce startup registry restore latency, move bulk registry work off the Gateway thread, batch registry cohorts, and avoid full-session scans when resuming ACP sessions. (#165942, #165684, #165098, #167684, #167010, #167372, #165550, #167086)

### Fixes

- **Session data safety:** preserve user input and committed facts through restart recovery and failed publication, keep accepted locked appends settled before releasing the writer, and fence cross-store worker commits. (#165502, #167570, #165894, #168018, #168029)
- **Session authority and privacy:** check caller authority before restoring cold history for compaction, keep authority current after committed session changes, reject malformed hook session keys, and hide pre-session edits to branch-added files from uncommitted diffs. (#166506, #167875, #166406, #164671) Thanks @yetval and @obviyus.
- **Session cleanup:** remove leftover GitHub publication receipts and managed worktrees on cleanup and Incognito reset, and publish conversation, plugin-state, sandbox, worktree, and GitHub authority receipts. (#163833, #165185, #167731, #168025) Thanks @jayzhou2309 and @obviyus.
- **Turn reliability:** recover agent turns when the database worker exits mid-operation, stop unrelated session writes from failing Codex and chat turns, keep Knowledge calls working while a session publishes its bookkeeping, and stop group turns from failing silently when history cannot load. (#163258, #165196, #166010, #166758, #135253, #166059) Thanks @goutamadwant, @hawkit, @jalehman, and @izshaw.
- **Restart recovery:** settle sessions left running after restart, avoid duplicate recovery after ordinary interruptions, keep recovery reconciliation on the host, and preserve database admission, custody, and hook retries for post-restart and first-session turns. (#165174, #154175, #166395, #166867, #166609, #167629, #165859, #165738, #166891) Thanks @Grynn and @RomneyDa.
- **Agent and session creation:** fix concurrent first requests for a new agent, cold shared-store and fresh-store creation failures, and agent database recovery after orphan session window repair. (#166003, #167257, #167515, #167366, #166860)
- **Windows and path aliases:** canonicalize the shared state database path and compare link-stable identities so Windows and POSIX path aliases share one store, custody, and channel lifecycle. (#166755, #165775, #166062, #166462, #166787) Thanks @taihartman, @donquiche61, @RomneyDa, and @ericcaiwx-star.
- **SQLite deadlocks and stalls:** prevent writer-reader admission and cleanup deadlocks, keep committed reads responsive during writer stalls, stop writer-held transcript reads waiting on readers, and keep foreign changes visible during refresh. (#167662, #167446, #167901, #167687, #166331, #165898, #167332) Thanks @sasan1200 and @vincentkoc.

name: v5.1.30
body:
**`ulw-research` reads sources in your own browser instead of fetching them.** The Phase 0 brief now decides `Collection: search-only | browser` by one rule (search-only only when a result snippet settles every axis), and the web workers read every candidate through the `browser` skill's attached engine: one named session per worker, one tab per source, several tabs side by side while comparing, with a full-page screenshot per top source. `webfetch` is reserved for raw files, hosts the browser cannot open go to `ultimate-browsing` with their provenance, and a team member's brief names the `browser` skill to read since members cannot carry `load_skills`. `ultimate-browsing` no longer presents itself as the research browsing lane, and the `browser` skill no longer sends plain page reading elsewhere. ([#9958](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9958), [#9959](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9959))

**Your first real prompt starts onboarding, not opening a session.** First-run context now rides along with the first prompt you actually send, without a separate model turn. The agent answers your request first, then offers the tour. Background, preview and headless sessions no longer use up onboarding, the TUI shows a static welcome until you ask something, and a failed or aborted first turn frees onboarding to try again. `--onboard` still starts the tour right away in the TUI, and in RPC it applies to the first real prompt. ([#9905](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9905), [#9907](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9907))

**Custom category models keep their own reasoning settings when background work starts or resumes.** A category with a model override or a `models` chain no longer inherits the builtin category's variant. Reasoning is resolved against the model actually selected before dispatch, with `reasoning` taking precedence over `reasoningEffort` and the legacy `variant`, and a resumed task keeps that model's generation settings. Builtin categories keep their existing defaults. Thanks to @MoerAI, @willowite and @pointfish6660. ([#8510](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/8510), [#9013](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9013))

**Groundwork for OmO accounts: `omo login`, `omo whoami` and `omo logout` ship ahead of the account service, which hasn't launched yet.** Until it does, `omo login` checks the service first and stops at once with a one-line error naming the service address, instead of opening a browser or waiting, and `omo whoami` reports that you aren't signed in. When the service launches, sign-in will use a browser flow or a headless device-code flow (`--device` or `--no-browser`), keep credentials and device keys only in the operating system's credential store (Keychain on macOS, Secret Service on Linux, Credential Manager on Windows) with no plaintext fallback, and keep a sign-in through connection and browser-launch failures. ([#9829](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9829), [#9811](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9811), [#9831](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9831), [#9833](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9833))

**A child stopped during parent teardown no longer briefly reports a failure of its own.** An unexpected exit is now held for a two-second confirmation window. If the owning manager survives, a genuine failure is reported; if the owner exits first, recovery records the interrupted work as `lost` without replaying it. Recovery also revisits children it had deferred to another live owner once that owner has exited, so those records no longer stay stranded. ([#9715](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9715), [#9884](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9884))

**One `task` call can submit more than 16 child tasks.** The per-call batch cap is gone from both validation and execution. Global, provider and model concurrency limits still decide how many children run at once; the rest queue and start as slots free up. Synchronous batch results still come back in input order. ([#9854](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9854), [#9859](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9859))

**`unspecified-low` uses GPT-6.1 Sol at medium reasoning on the OpenAI lanes.** The default chain adds `gpt-6.1-sol` for OpenAI API and ChatGPT Subscription ahead of the older GPT fallback. GPT-5.6 Terra is replaced by GPT-5.6 Sol at medium reasoning, which keeps a supported fallback for GitHub Copilot, OpenCode and catalogs without 6.1 Sol. Other categories keep their defaults. ([#9844](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9844), [#9845](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9845))

**Windows hook commands and plugin updates no longer open extra console windows.** Claude-compatible hooks and helper probes now hide their child consoles, so a GUI-launched session doesn't get a terminal flash or a focus-stealing window on every hook. The shared Bun spawn path applies the same setting, and OmO's Codex plugin hides consoles for background updates, version checks and manual-update commands. ([#7144](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/7144), [#9837](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9837), [#9840](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9840), [#9841](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9841), [#9838](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9838), [#9839](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9839))

**OpenCode session tools can find sessions across projects, not just the current server directory.** Session listing and cross-session search use the paginated global session endpoint when it's available, keep their project and date filters, and fall back to the existing session list when it isn't. Search still caps how many sessions it scans. Thanks to @MoerAI. ([#5810](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/5810), [#9023](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9023))

**Computer use can inspect and select macOS menu-bar commands by their menu path.** `win.menu.items(path?)` lists titles, paths, enabled and checked states, submenus and shortcuts, and `win.menu.select(path)` invokes one unambiguous, enabled leaf command. Selection re-checks the target window and command right before dispatch and restores the keyboard context afterwards. Ambiguous labels, disabled items and submenu-only targets are refused, and on macOS an app with several windows is refused rather than risking the wrong one. The API is cross-platform, but native support in this release is macOS only. ([#9875](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9875), [#9881](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9881), [#9886](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9886))

**Setting a macOS popup now picks the option instead of reporting an ignored write as success.** `el.setValue(text)` opens the popup's menu, selects the exact matching option and verifies the result. Missing, ambiguous and disabled options are refused with the available choices. A menu the call opened is closed again whether selection succeeds or fails, while one that was already open is left alone. Pull-down popups aren't supported yet. ([#9852](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9852))

**Computer use can write ISO-8601 values to macOS date and time controls.** `el.setValue(text)` now writes a native date and reads it back to verify. A date-only value keeps the current time of day, local date-times use the system time zone, and values with `Z` or a numeric offset name an exact instant. Malformed input, and local times that daylight saving skips or repeats, are refused rather than quietly shifted. ([#9853](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9853))

**Computer-use timeout messages show where the desktop engine stopped answering.** A failed startup probe now names its handshake phase: neither reply yet, `engine.hello` answered while capabilities are pending, or capabilities answered while `engine.hello` is pending. A stalled engine is easier to diagnose when every timeout no longer looks the same. Thanks to @MoerAI. ([#9720](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9720), [#9742](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9742), [#9916](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9916))

**Foreground computer use now needs your explicit OK.** Before the model can type, click in the foreground or raise a window, its computer code calls `desktop.control.acquire({ reason })`, and OmO asks you to confirm with that reason. Only an explicit yes grants control; declining, letting the 45-second prompt time out, a headless run or a read-only run all leave it ungranted. The grant ends when the model releases it, when the run ends or fails, on the stop chord, or when the session closes, and resuming never restores it. One session's grant is never taken over by another. Background delivery is unchanged and stays the default. ([#9899](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9899), [#9908](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9908))

**Thread bindings accept WhatsApp as a native platform.** `thread_bind` and the session-gateway store now accept `whatsapp` instead of refusing a connector's first message, and existing bindings are kept as the store upgrades. This is the core binding support a WhatsApp connector needs; it doesn't install or link one by itself. ([#9871](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9871))

**Workflow node IDs are checked before their results are stored.** Empty IDs, `.` and `..`, path separators, colons and NUL bytes are rejected with `invalid_node_id` instead of being used to build result paths, and the result store refuses unsafe paths too. An existing run whose node IDs contain those characters can't resume its saved results after upgrading: rename the nodes and restart the run. Thanks to @DeryFerd. ([#9869](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9869))

**Mass-ulw joins adjacent all-to-all waves through one review node.** The planning guide now puts a single verification node between two complete waves instead of drawing every producer-to-consumer edge. A finding reruns only the producer it names, and a consumer that needs just one branch waits on that branch's review alone. ([#9866](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9866))

**omo.dev download stats are set to refresh hourly.** The downloads worker now schedules its rollup at 17 minutes past each hour, so the public stats update regularly once the worker runs with its analytics credential. Nothing changes in your local install. ([#9827](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9827))

**omo runs on senpi 2026.10.11, and a task shard stops soon after the session that owns it exits.** Task shards are now started with senpi's caller-lifetime ownership, so a multi-GB `p-*` shard host no longer stays resident for the full idle window after its owning session quits; peers and running turns still keep it alive. The engine also waits for its host child to really exit before releasing a stopped host, and required compaction no longer wedges on an unsafe newest message. Long sessions stop rewriting the prompt cache every turn: context reduction holds a stable prefix between large steps and survives restarts. OpenAI models behind a Responses-compatible gateway no longer fail every turn with `Invalid value: 'allowed_tools'`. The footer shows a reasoning model's level as `effort <level>` next to the key that changes it (`shift+tab` by default) when the footer has room. Reloading a session no longer keeps the previous extension runner in memory, and the runtime snapshot a first launch builds leaves out dependency development trees and redundant TypeScript sources. Full engine notes: [senpi 2026.10.10-12](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/releases/tag/v2026.10.10-12) and [senpi 2026.10.11](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/releases/tag/v2026.10.11). (code-yeongyu/senpi#3044, code-yeongyu/senpi#3054, code-yeongyu/senpi#3060, code-yeongyu/senpi#900, code-yeongyu/senpi#3080, code-yeongyu/senpi#3090, code-yeongyu/senpi#3066, code-yeongyu/senpi#3083, [#9876](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9876), [#9976](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9976))

**Suspended children no longer linger in the task list: each one resumes or ends on its own.** A child that was parked while it could not run is now revived as soon as it can be, or ends within a bounded recovery window with one final result, so it never sits in the task list as suspended. Messages sent to it meanwhile are queued and delivered in order when it resumes; if it can't resume, the parent is told in that one result how many messages were not delivered, and `task_output` then shows `error` rather than the original status. ([#9861](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9861), [#9868](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9868))

name: CC Switch v4.0.8
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.8

### 4.0 正式版的第四个修复版本

只装了 Codex 桌面版、没有单独装 Codex 命令行的用户，现在也能用 Codex 聚合模式了。官方模型列表读不到时，提示会写明原因，问题解决后提示也会自己消失。添加和编辑供应商时，「获取模型列表」会带上你配置的请求头，需要额外请求头的网关不会再拒绝。「设置 → 数据」新增「打开日志」按钮。深色模式的文字调暗了一些，不再那么刺眼。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 [v4.0 发布说明](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.4-zh.md)。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.8-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.8-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

**「设置 → 数据 → 应用诊断日志」新增「打开日志」按钮。** 点击后会在系统的文件管理器里选中 `cc-switch.log`；日志文件还没生成时打开日志所在的文件夹。报告问题时可以直接把它附上，不用再去找隐藏的配置目录。

## 修复

- **只装了 Codex 桌面版时，聚合页提示「读取不到 Codex 模型列表」，聚合模式用不了。** 联网获取官方列表失败时，CC Switch 会改用 Codex 命令行自带的模型列表，但以前只在系统路径里找 `codex` 命令。只装桌面版的用户没有这个命令，所以一直失败。现在找不到时会再去用 Codex 桌面版自带的命令行：macOS 上找「应用程序」里的 ChatGPT.app 和改名前的 Codex.app，两个都在时用 ChatGPT.app，避免旧的 Codex.app 给出过时的模型列表；Windows 上找桌面版安装目录里最新的一个版本。单独安装的 Codex 命令行仍然优先。
- **官方模型列表读不到时，提示看不出原因，问题解决后提示也不会消失。** 以前所有原因都显示成同一句「读取不到 Codex 模型列表」。现在提示下面会列出具体原因，并告诉你怎么处理：Codex 没有可用的 ChatGPT 登录、登录超过 8 天没有刷新、登录信息不完整、读不到 Codex 版本、联网获取失败、返回的数据不完整；Codex 自带的列表则分为找不到 Codex 命令行、命令行没能输出列表、列表里没有能用的模型。联网失败和命令行失败的详细信息会写进日志。另外，以前换用备用列表后，即使官方列表后来恢复了（比如过期的登录被 Codex 自动刷新），提示也要等你下次手动切换才会消失；现在 CC Switch 会自动换回官方列表，提示随之消失。
- **「获取模型列表」不带你配置的请求头，需要额外请求头的网关会拒绝。** 比如 Cloudflare AI Gateway 要求 `cf-aig-authorization` 请求头。现在 OpenCode 供应商会带上它配置的请求头；Claude Code、Codex 和 Grok Build 供应商会带上「Header 覆盖」里填的请求头，格式不对或留空时照常获取。在 Codex 和 Grok Build 的表单里修改「Header 覆盖」后，已经获取的模型列表会清空，避免选到当前身份用不了的模型。
- **深色模式的文字太亮，看久了刺眼。** 三档文字颜色都接近纯白，满屏表格和标签时显得很冲，主次也分不清。现在三档都调暗了一些，次要文字在卡片和选中背景上仍然保持足够的对比度。浅色模式没有变化。

**其他：**
- v4.0.7 发布说明里「压缩 Codex 历史会话」一节补充了怎么打开、什么时候压缩、怎么继续旧会话、CC Switch 里怎么显示和需要注意的地方。
- 英文和日文的额度显示说明、英文、日文和繁体中文的备份提示，改用界面上实际显示的名称。

## 升级说明

**数据库结构没有变化**，仍然是 20。

---

## 致谢

感谢 @SailingLoong（OpenCode 获取模型列表时带上请求头）、@ggbdpq（Claude Code、Codex 获取模型列表时带上「Header 覆盖」）的贡献。

感谢 @xovow、@YX-bobi、@cydebbb 报告问题和提出建议。

完整的技术细节请见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。

name: MinerU 4.0.12
body:
## 更新内容 / What's Changed

**新增 / Features**
- V1 API：自部署 API 与 Router 新增 `/v1/tasks` 异步便捷接口和 `/v1/file_parse` 同步包装，支持一次提交文件、查询状态及获取 JSON/ZIP 结果；与 `/v1/parse/jobs` 共用任务 ID / V1 API: add asynchronous `/v1/tasks` and synchronous `/v1/file_parse` convenience endpoints to self-hosted API servers and Routers, with one-request file submission, status queries and JSON/ZIP results sharing the existing parse-job IDs
- 上传复用：支持 SHA-256 预检及已有 `file_id` 复用；原始字节入口在缓存命中时可提前返回，客户端示例见 `scripts/http_task_example.sh` / Upload reuse: support SHA-256 preflight and existing `file_id` references; the raw-byte endpoint can respond before reading the body on cache hits, with a client example in `scripts/http_task_example.sh`

**改进 / Improvements**
- Router：按健康状态、解析能力及未完成任务负载调度，同负载轮询；完善跨 worker 输入复制、任务预占和失败/取消/终态后的负载释放 / Router: schedule by worker health, parsing capabilities and unfinished-job load, rotate among equal-load workers, and improve cross-worker input copying, reservations and load release
- 资源保留：API 与 Router 默认在 24 小时后回收过期资源；可通过 `--retention-seconds` 或 `MINERU_API_RETENTION_SECONDS` 配置，设为 `0` 禁用自动回收 / Retention: API servers and Routers collect expired resources after 24 hours by default; configure `--retention-seconds` or `MINERU_API_RETENTION_SECONDS`, and use `0` to disable automatic collection
- 模型生命周期：识别致命引擎错误并返回 `503 engine_dead`，托管 worker 支持代际恢复和退避，防止过期响应污染新 worker / Model lifecycle: detect fatal engine errors and return `503 engine_dead`, recover managed worker generations with backoff, and reject stale responses
- Torch CPU：按显式线程配置、有效 CPU 配额及已有线程上限限制算子线程，并传播到后续工作线程 / Torch CPU: cap operator threads using explicit settings, effective CPU quotas and existing lower limits, and apply the selected limit to subsequent worker threads
- API 文档：Swagger/ReDoc 使用本地资源，支持离线访问、Bearer 授权及反向代理路径前缀 / API documentation: serve Swagger/ReDoc assets locally, with offline access, Bearer authorization and reverse-proxy path prefixes

**修复 / Fixes**
- Router：任务保留期从跨 worker 副本清理完成后开始；过期回收及 worker 移除不再减少调用方累计用量；非法输出格式在 worker 调度前返回请求错误 / Router: start job retention after cross-worker input cleanup, preserve per-owner lifetime usage through collection and worker removal, and reject invalid output formats before worker selection
- PDF：修复原生文本的中日韩边界标点和生成空格处理，统一 Python/Rust 路径；补充扫描件路由和原生表格模型回退回归 / PDF: repair CJK boundary punctuation and generated-space handling across Python/Rust paths, with regression coverage for scanned-PDF routing and native-table model fallback
- 版面分析：恢复 PP-DocLayoutV2 的模型分类阈值，统一 Torch/ONNX 输出过滤与阅读顺序候选有效性 / Layout: restore PP-DocLayoutV2 model class thresholds and align Torch/ONNX output filtering with reading-order candidate validity
- Office：通过 DocVortex 公共解析接口保留 DOCX/PPTX 表格内的富文本超链接 / Office: preserve rich-text hyperlinks in DOCX/PPTX tables through public DocVortex parsing interfaces

**依赖 / Dependencies**
- docvortex 最低版本提升至 0.5.16（`>=0.5.16,<1`）/ Require docvortex>=0.5.16,<1
- 新增 fastapi-offline（`>=1.7.7,<2`）/ Add fastapi-offline>=1.7.7,<2

**升级提示 / Upgrade Notes**
- 便捷接口位于 V1 命名空间；同步等待超时返回 `202` 和任务引用，任务继续执行，客户端可继续查询结果 / Convenience endpoints use the V1 namespace; synchronous wait timeouts return `202` with task references while the task continues, so clients can keep polling for results
- 长期保存产物时，请在资源保留期限内下载，或按部署需求调整保留时间 / Download outputs within the retention period for long-term storage, or adjust retention to suit your deployment

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/opendatalab/MinerU/compare/mineru-4.0.11-released...mineru-4.0.12-released

## What's Changed
### 🚨 Security
* Improve MCP startup compatibility and lazy-load CLI commands by @Shockang in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/207
* test: add integration test coverage and fix KuzuDB fork crashes by @magyargergo in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/209
### 🚀 Features
* feat(hooks): auto-reindex after git commit with embeddings preservation by @L1nusB in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/205
* feat: HTTP embedding backend for self-hosted/remote endpoints by @zm2231 in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/395

* feat: add docker support by @BRAINIFII in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/848
### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* fix: set env.cacheDir to user-writable location by @enihcam in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/845
* fix: devendor tree-sitter-proto install lifecycle to prevent ENOTEMPTY on global upgrade by @magyargergo in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/846
* fix: shard parse cache persistence on large repos by @BlackOvOoo in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/1580
* fix(rust): respect Cargo target boundaries in name fallback by @Sweetdevil144 in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/3294
### 🏎️ Performance

### 👷 CI/CD

* workflow: triage reporting by @zander-raycraft in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/421

name: v0.9.85
body:
A language-extraction and tooling batch: six extractor/exporter fixes picked from open issues, plus fourteen community pull requests.

- Fix: **Julia** functions with a `where` clause (long and short form) and parametric type definitions (`struct Box{T}`, `abstract type Shape{T}`, `struct Sq{T} <: Shape{T}`) are now extracted. The name sat inside a `where_expression` / `parametrized_type_expression` wrapper that the name lookup skipped, so the whole method/type was dropped; a declared type parameter (`value::T`) no longer leaks as a phantom field-type node (#4126, #4128).
- Fix: **Fortran** a named generic `interface` now gets a callable node and a `dispatches_to` edge to each listed `module procedure`, so a call to the generic name resolves instead of dangling; unnamed and operator/assignment interfaces are unaffected (#4141, #4142, thanks @rajatnagda45).
- Fix: **Elixir** `defdelegate` is now extracted as a function definition, so the delegated function appears and same-module calls to it resolve (#4132).
- Fix: **Scala 3** `given ... with` instance methods are scoped to the given instead of leaking to file scope (where they collided with the same-named trait type); an anonymous `given Show[Int] with` keeps its members under a synthesized name (#4130).
- Fix: **graph.html** a node label containing an unclosed `<!--` then `<script` can no longer break out of the embedded data script and blank the page; every `<` in the embedded JSON is escaped (#4124).
- Fix: the incomplete-extraction message now explains a pure semantic omission (a smaller `--token-budget` is the lever) instead of always blaming truncation (#4101, #4280, thanks @ayushcodes10).
- Fix: **TypeScript** `export type *` star re-exports no longer trip a spurious syntax-error flag that skewed the health report (#3942, #4303, thanks @ayushcodes10).
- Fix: **Rust** a cross-file reference to a type with impl blocks in other files now binds to the single declaration instead of a sourceless stub, fail-closed (#4283, #4284, thanks @Alin1233).
- Fix: distinct files that mint the same node id after the extension is dropped (`x.py` vs `x.html`) are kept as separate nodes instead of collapsing and losing one (#4281, #4282, thanks @bitwizard25).
- Fix: the git hook now updates the graph for files whose names contain non-ASCII characters (`core.quotePath=false` plus C-quote decoding) (#4278, #4279, thanks @smngvlkz).
- Fix: **watch** the rebuild lock no longer unlinks on release while a waiter holds it, closing a race that let two rebuilds run at once (POSIX) (#4273, #4277, thanks @ayushcodes10).
- Fix: an unanchored ignore pattern is now matched against the entry name only (so `*` no longer crosses `/` and negations behave like git) (#4242, #4251, thanks @Yyunozor).
- Fix: the hook-guard Read nudge now fires for PowerShell source files (`.ps1`/`.psm1`/`.psd1`) (#4271, #4272, thanks @rtmalikian).
- Fix: the skill now tells you that `graphify-out/` was written into your working tree, with how to gitignore or share it (#3941, #4308, thanks @eoinforker).
- Fix: `graphify affected <Symbol>` now reaches callers through the symbol's defining file, so Dart/Flutter (and other file-module languages) return results instead of nothing (#4288, #4290, thanks @dcaldr).
- Fix: an `export default` with a huge base64 literal plus a tsconfig `baseUrl` no longer crashes extraction with "File name too long" (#4166, #4169, thanks @bastiennoel93).
- Fix: markdown links to a file name containing a space (`[x](<My Note.md>)`, `[x](My%20Note.md)`) now resolve to a references edge (#4177, #4178, thanks @Yyunozor).
- Perf: skip a per-call `os.getcwd()` in the path-memo key for absolute paths, and walk each JS/TS tree once when collecting symbol facts — both output-identical (#4301, #4302, thanks @pishuv).
